title: 选词中的固定搭配
goal: 根据常用搭配选择符合语境的候选词。

points.label: 识别常用词语之间的搭配
根据搭配限制选择候选词

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 搭配是经常一起使用的词语组合，如 make progress（取得进步）。选词时先看空格前后的词能否和候选词组成搭配，再核对整句的意思。

cards.title: 动词与名词
rows: The class made progress in reading.
The group made a decision yesterday.
Residents took action to clean the park.
The team reached a conclusion after discussion.
The new schedule solved a problem.
The guide provides information about the museum.
The team conducts research on learning.
The service meets a local need.

cards.title: 形容词与名词
rows: The work gave her valuable experience.
The local community supported the project.
The group works with limited resources.
The teacher paid close attention to the answer.
The schedule underwent a major change.
The teams share a common goal.

cards.title: 动词与介词
rows: The books belong to the library.
The guide responded to the question.
The class prepared for the visit.
The children benefit from the program.
The report refers to the survey.
The repair resulted in a delay.

cards.title: 名词与介词
rows: The ramp provides access to the building.
The rain was the reason for the delay.
She has an interest in history.
The change had an effect on travel.
The team found a solution to the problem.
The survey showed an increase in visits.
The report explains the difference between the plans.
The letter was a response to the request.
The course offers an opportunity for practice.
The town has a demand for clean water.

items.stem: The ramp gives visitors access _____ the building.
items.why: access to 表示进入的机会。
depend on 表示依靠；植物依靠水生长。

items.stem: The class discussed the problem and reached a _____.
items.why: reach a conclusion 表示得出结论。need 与 meet 搭配，不与 reach 搭配。

items.stem: The new service meets a local _____.
items.why: meet a need 表示满足需要。

items.stem: The report focuses _____ the new schedule.
The group found a solution _____ the problem.
items.why: solution to 表示问题的解决办法。

items.stem: The students _____ in a discussion after reading.
items.why: participate in 表示参加。result in 也接 in，但表示导致，主语是事情，不是人。

items.stem: The team will _____ research on study habits.
items.why: conduct research 表示开展研究。

items.stem: The volunteers gained valuable _____ from the work.
items.why: gain experience 表示获得经验，valuable experience 表示宝贵的经验。progress 与 make 搭配，不与 gain 搭配。

items.stem: The rain was the reason _____ the delay.
The guide _____ information about the building.
items.why: provide information 表示提供信息。

groups.fill: A class planned a visit to a museum. The teacher provided clear instru{ctions} for the trip. Students took no{tes} during the visit and later shared information. The group made prog{ress} in its research on local history. Members reached a concl{usion} after comparing their notes. They had access to useful books at the library. The project offered an oppor{tunity} for practice. It also gave them valuable exper{ience}. Their teacher paid close atte{ntion} to the final report. Students had an inte{rest} in the topic and shared a common go{al}. The local comm{unity} received a copy of the report.

items.stem: The students will _____ notes during the lecture.
The team reached a _____ after discussion.
items.why: reach a conclusion 表示得出结论。

items.stem: The new timetable had an effect _____ travel.
items.why: effect on 表示对……的影响。
participate in 表示参加。result in 也接 in，但表示导致，主语是事情，不是人。
public transport 表示公共交通。

items.stem: The library gives residents access _____ books.
items.why: access to 表示使用的机会。
